content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CSIR CFTRI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Associate II (PAT II) and 1 for Project Assistant II (PA II).

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate – II (PAT-II): M.Sc. in Biochemistry / Chemistry / Biotechnology / Food Science and Nutrition / Microbiology or equivalent from a recognized university AND 2 years of experience in research and development or Science communication in Industrial / Academic Institution / Science & Technology organization. Project Assistant – II (PA-II): B.Sc. in Food Science & nutrition or equivalent from a recognized university OR 3 years Diploma in Chemical Engineering/ Biotechnology.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Age Relaxation: SC/ST/PwBD/Women: 5 years, OBC: 3 years To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Project Associate II (PAT-II): Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA Project Assistant II (PA-II): Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR CFTRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR CFTRI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 is 14 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Associate-II and Project Assistant-II in this CSIR CFTRI recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: For Project Associate-II, candidates need an M.Sc. in Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Food Science and Nutrition, or Microbiology, along with 2 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CSIR CFTRI posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this CSIR CFTRI recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 28,000/- per month, plus HRA, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications for the CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR CFTRI located?
faq.answer: CSIR CFTRI is located in Mysuru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a Diploma apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a 3 years Diploma in Chemical Engineering/ Biotechnology are eligible to apply for the Project Assistant-II post.
